author: Jeff Geerling
description:
Good times are meant to be shared, so I put mine in the NTP Pool.

For a good time:

  - From time to time: https://time.jeffgeerling.com
  - ALL the time: https://www.ntppool.org/en/use.html

And if you want to set up your own Time Pi like I have, I put all the source and documentation here:
https://github.com/geerlingguy/time-pi

HomelabFest: https://www.homelabfest.org

Also check out my blog post with more details on the setup:
https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2026/i-joined-the-ntp-pool/

Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/geerlingguy
Sponsor me on GitHub: https://github.com/sponsors/geerlingguy
Merch: https://www.redshirtjeff.com
2nd Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@GeerlingEngineering
3rd Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@Level2Jeff
